column3: Close to the Hebrew; מַעֲלֵה (“platform, ascent”) is rendered “the stairs.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Sea of Reeds” is rendered by its traditional name “the Red Sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; “which you had lifted your hand to give” is rendered “had sworn to give.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a God of forgivenesses” is rendered “God, Ready to pardon,” and “great of covenant loyalty” “Abundant in kindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; נֶאָצוֹת (“blasphemies”) is rendered “provocations.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you apportioned them to a corner” is rendered “divided them into districts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “blasphemies” is rendered “provocations.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they gave a stubborn shoulder” is rendered “they shrugged their shoulders.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you prolonged toward them many years” is rendered “for many years You had patience with them.”
